zero_direct_store_access.evidence: Browser communicates strictly via /api/v1 REST and SSE endpoints; zero direct SQLite or client-side duplicate database.

zero_browser_secrets.evidence: No API keys, credentials, or session secrets stored in localStorage/sessionStorage; double-submit CSRF with HttpOnly session cookies.

canonical_runtime_mutations.evidence: All task claims, runs, cancels, retries, reviews, memory promotions and rollbacks execute through canonical MARSHAL runtime services.

security_headers_and_csp.evidence: Strict CSP (default-src 'self'), X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, SameSite=Lax cookies, and Origin validation enforced.

bounded_limitations: High-throughput log streams (>500 lines/sec) are windowed in visible DOM to 2,000 lines to prevent DOM freeze.
Realtime SSE stream reconnects replay the last 500 ring-buffer frames; older events require pagination API queries.
Air-gapped operation supported via Go compile-time embed.FS without external CDNs.
